halfmoon-films.name: Halfmoon Films
halfmoon-films.about: An independent studio in Portland. Short fiction, mostly about people leaving rooms.

elena-vasquez.name: Elena Vasquez
elena-vasquez.about: Filmmaker. Documentaries about work: the people who keep things running.

gridline-motion.name: Gridline Motion
gridline-motion.about: Motion design studio. Title sequences, explainers and the occasional loop for its own sake.

northlight-docs.name: Northlight Documentary
northlight-docs.about: Documentary collective from Oslo. Long shots, cold water, patient subjects.

tomas-reyes.name: Tomas Reyes
tomas-reyes.about: Cinematographer. Camera tests, lighting breakdowns and the odd personal film.

paper-lantern.name: Paper Lantern Animation
paper-lantern.about: Hand-drawn animation from a studio of four in Kyoto. Every frame on paper first.

the-last-shift.title: The Last Shift
the-last-shift.description: A night baker closes the shop for the final time and finds she cannot leave the ovens. Short fiction, 14 minutes.

comments.author: elena-vasquez
comments.text: The ovens are a character. Beautifully restrained.

harbour-lights.title: Harbour Lights
harbour-lights.description: Two ferry workers on the last crossing of the year. Dialogue improvised over four nights.

comments.author: tomas-reyes
comments.text: How did you expose for the deck lights? Genuinely asking.

the-corridor.title: The Corridor
the-corridor.description: A single take down a hospital corridor at 3am. Nine minutes, one shot, no cuts.

comments.author: gridline-motion
comments.text: the title card at the end is a lesson in restraint

keepers.title: Keepers
keepers.description: A year with the three people who maintain the last hand-wound clock tower in the county. Feature documentary, 62 minutes.

comments.author: northlight-docs
comments.text: The winter sequence is extraordinary. We are jealous of the light.

night-crew.title: Night Crew
night-crew.description: The overnight team at a city transit depot, told in a single shift. 24 minutes.

comments.author: halfmoon-films
comments.text: the bus wash sequence is pure cinema

the-linemen.title: The Linemen
the-linemen.description: Power line crews after an ice storm. Shot over eleven days with a crew of two.

comments.author: tomas-reyes
comments.text: the ice on the lens at 18:00 is a happy accident I would keep

loop-study-3.title: Loop Study 3
loop-study-3.description: A twelve-second loop about gears that do not quite mesh. Made for no client.

comments.author: tomas-reyes
comments.text: I have had this open in a tab for a week

how-clocks-drift.title: How clocks drift (explainer)
how-clocks-drift.description: A four-minute explainer on clock drift for a client that lets us publish it. Distributed systems, but pretty.

cold-water.title: Cold Water
cold-water.description: Winter swimmers on the Oslo fjord, before dawn, for a whole season. 38 minutes.

comments.author: elena-vasquez
comments.text: Every frame is patient. I want to know your shooting ratio.

the-ferry-year.title: The Ferry Year
the-ferry-year.description: One ferry, one crew, four seasons. Companion piece to Cold Water.

comments.author: halfmoon-films
comments.text: our ferry film and yours should screen together

camera-test-dusk.title: Camera test: dusk, three sensors
camera-test-dusk.description: Same street, same hour, three cameras. Notes on highlight roll-off in the description of each shot.

comments.author: gridline-motion
comments.text: the middle sensor is the one, right?

lighting-breakdown-kitchen.title: Lighting breakdown: the kitchen scene
lighting-breakdown-kitchen.description: How a two-light setup became a four-light setup and then went back. From a short I shot last spring.

comments.author: halfmoon-films
comments.text: this is the scene from Harbour Lights, for anyone wondering

paper-boat.title: Paper Boat
paper-boat.description: A boy folds a boat that keeps unfolding. Hand-drawn, 4,200 frames, seven months.

comments.author: gridline-motion
comments.text: 7 months for 6 minutes. this is what patience looks like.

lantern-festival.title: Lantern Festival (process film)
lantern-festival.description: Twelve minutes on how the studio made the festival sequence: pencil tests, ink, colour, compositing.

comments.author: tomas-reyes
comments.text: the ink stage is a lighting lesson in itself
